summary: 24-year-old Grand Junction woman ran and jumped from a cliff near Cold Shivers Point (witness 911 call Friday); Mesa County Technical Rescue Team recovered her body the next day via an ~300-ft technical raise, with Glade Park and Grand Junction fire departments assisting overnight.
responding_agency: NPS rangers; Mesa County Technical Rescue Team; Glade Park FD; Grand Junction FD
notes: Incident 2011-09-09 (Friday); body recovered Saturday 2011-09-10; Mesa County Coroner investigated.
